title: Euler's map of Königsberg
alt: Euler's line drawing of Königsberg: the river flows round the island A and joins another branch beside the land D; seven bridges, labelled a to g, connect the four land areas A, B, C and D.
author: Leonhard Euler
description: Figure 1 from Solutio problematis ad geometriam situs pertinentis by Leonhard Euler, better known as The Seven Bridges of Königsberg.
